messages.text:
Hi, I’m about to place an order for the Magic Miner 40T to Spain. The checkout shows $799 + $40 shipping, with “customs & duties prepaid (DDP)”, for a total of $839.

Could you please confirm that this $839 total includes the Spanish 21% VAT and all import duties/customs charges, and that I will not have to pay anything else upon delivery?

Thank you.
Handed to the team · Checkout is showing "customs & duties prepaid (DDP)" on a Spain order, but VAT i

I don't want you ordering on a wrong assumption: the $839 does not include Spanish VAT. VAT is 21% and it's payable at customs on delivery, so on the $799 unit that's a real extra cost to you, not something we've prepaid.

The D. wording at checkout conflicts with that, so I've asked the team to confirm exactly what is and isn't covered on a Spain shipment before you pay. Stay in the chat, one of them will jump in here, and you'll get it by email if you step away.

Hi, thank you for checking this with your team.

Before I place the order, I would like to have the exact total cost for delivery to Spain confirmed.

The checkout currently shows:

* Magic Miner 40T: $799
* Shipping: $40
* Total: $839
* Shipping option: “Standard Shipping, customs & duties prepaid (DDP)”

However, I understand that the 21% Spanish VAT is not included and would be payable upon importation.

Could you please confirm:

1. Whether the $839 includes all customs duties and import charges except Spanish VAT.
2. Exactly how much Spanish VAT I will have to pay.
3. Whether there will be any additional customs clearance, courier or handling fees when the package arrives in Spain.
4. Most importantly, what the final total cost will be for me in Spain, with no other charges afterwards.

I would like to know the complete delivered cost before placing the order.

Thank you for your help

Straight answer: I can't give you a guaranteed delivered total yet, and I won't guess at one.

What I do know is the 21% VAT is on you, charged at import. On $799 that's about $168, though Spanish customs set the value they apply it to, not us.

The duty side, any courier handling fee, and what that DDP line actually covers are exactly what the team is confirming. That's already with them. Stay in the chat and you'll get the full figure here, or by email if you step away.

Hi, I have noticed that the Magic Miner 40T product page currently states “Import VAT included in price” and “Ships from within EU”.

This seems to contradict the information I received in the chat saying that the 21% Spanish VAT would be charged to me at import.

Could you please clarify which information applies to my order to Spain?

If the unit is shipped from within the EU, will I have to pay any additional Spanish VAT, customs duties, or import/handling fees upon delivery?

If the $799 price includes the applicable VAT, could you please confirm that $799 + the $40 shipping is the complete amount payable by me, with no additional charges on delivery?

I would appreciate written confirmation before placing the order. Thank you

I can see the product description on my side and it says nothing about VAT being included or an EU warehouse for this unit. So I can't confirm that wording, and I won't tell you $839 is your final number when what I have says the 21% VAT is charged to you at import.

That badge versus what we've told buyers is exactly the conflict the team is settling. I've given them your Spain question in full. Stay in the chat and you'll get one clear written answer, here or by email.
